scope: One original MuLoRA T1 completion plus same-encoder readouts and fixed stored-logit centering; no history training
H1: Sum normalized CLS by class across clients under ONE frozen global encoder; normalize final class sum
test_policy: All fixed heads reported; no test-based hyperparameter, head or checkpoint selection; no validation claims for full-train data
repair_artifact_policy: Always save independently named H1 candidate, irrespective of test accuracy; call improvement verified only if fixed comparison supports it, do not select H2/H3 as replacement based on test
T3_intervention: Single predetermined subtraction of within-training-block mean per sample; every block, no true sample task ID
snapshot_policy: Retain all round global states and all local B/head endpoints without consuming training RNG; evaluate after training
comparison: Reuse LoRM official original final T1 0.977 and round scores; no LoRM retraining
